guide_1: **1.** Open [discord.com/developers/applications](https://discord.com/developers/applications) and click “New Application”. Copy its “Application ID”.
guide_2: **2.** Open the “Bot” tab and create the bot's secret code. Copy it. Leave every “Privileged Gateway Intent” off.
guide_3: **3.** In Discord, turn on Developer Mode (Settings, Advanced). Right-click your server and choose “Copy Server ID”. Then click “Register the bot” and paste the three values.
guide_4: **4.** The card then shows “Add the bot to the server”. Click it and confirm in Discord.
remove_confirm: Remove the bot from this site? Modules stop posting to Discord until a bot is registered again. Messages already on Discord stay.
fix_guild: Add the bot to the server
health_token: Discord refuses the bot's secret code.
health_guild: The bot is not on your server.
health_perms: The bot lacks a permission for {feature}: {list}.
health_rate: Discord asks for a pause until {time}.
test_none: No bot is registered. Click “Register the bot”.
test_token: Discord refuses the bot's secret code. Open “Edit” and paste a new one.
test_guild: The bot is not on your server. Click “Add the bot to the server”.
test_rate: Discord asks for a pause until {time}. Try again then.
test_net: Discord does not answer. Try again in a few minutes.
test_missing: The bot answers but lacks on the whole server: {list}. Add it again with the button to fix this.
test_ok: Discord answers and the bot is on your server.
err_app: Write the application number: digits only, for example 123456789012345678.
err_guild: Write the server number: digits only, for example 123456789012345678.
err_secret: Paste the bot's secret code as Discord shows it, without spaces.
forget_confirm: Delete this message on Discord? The module writes it again at its next update.
not_found: This message is no longer kept. Reload the page.
why_invalid_input: Discord was asked something it cannot do.
why_forbidden: Discord refuses: the bot lacks a permission.
why_not_found: Discord does not know this message.
why_not_member: The person or the bot is not on the server.
why_rate_limited: Discord asks for a pause. Try again later.
why_unavailable: Discord does not answer. Try again later.
err_owner_only: Only the owner can change the Discord bot.
reason_owner_only: Ask the owner to fix the Discord bot.
